note: Ana is going to the mall but needs directions. She approaches one person, asks for help and hears Sorry, no. A clear transition introduces Luis as a different helper. He agrees, hears the named destination, gives a usable route, receives thanks, and Ana follows the route to the mall. This is where the fuller story and conversation belong. This is the former proposed 6.9, renumbered 6.10 by the new Going lesson. The screenshot’s Thank you / Sorry, no task has no defensible photo-only answer. Replace that recognition task with visible route meaning; retain actual reply discrimination in listening and contextual production. Do not add a text-only Recognize conversation quiz or a new dialogue layout.
